test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
After interchanging which two signs, the value of the given equation will be '1'?

12 × 6 - 28 + 3 ÷ 9
solution:
Given equation: 12 × 6 - 28 + 3 ÷ 9 = 1.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) × and +

Given: 12 × 6 - 28 + 3 ÷ 9 = 1

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 12 + 6 - __**28 × 3 ÷ 9**__ = 1

⇒ __**12 + 6**__ - 9.33 = 1

⇒ __18 - 9.33__ = 1

⇒ 8.67 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) + and -

Given: 12 × 6 - 28 + 3 ÷ 9 = 1

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 12 × 6 + 28 - __**3 ÷ 9**__ = 1

⇒ __**12 × 6**__ + 28 - 0.33 = 1

⇒ __**72 + 28**__ - 0.33 = 1

⇒ __**100 - 0.33**__ = 1

⇒ 99.67 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) **÷ and ×**

Given: 12 × 6 - 28 + 3 ÷ 9 = 1

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ __**12 ÷ 6**__ - 28 + 3 × 9 = 1

⇒ 2 - 28 + __**3 × 9**__ = 1

⇒ __**2**__ - 28 __**+ 27**__ = 1

⇒ __29** - 28**__ = 1

⇒ **1** = 1

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 4) × and -

Given: 12 × 6 - 28 + 3 ÷ 9 = 1

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 12 - 6 × 28 + __**3 ÷ 9**__ = 1

⇒ 12 - __**6 × 28**__ + 0.33 = 1

⇒ __**12**__ - 168 __**+ 0.33**__ = 1

⇒ __12.33** - 168**__ = 1

⇒ 155.67 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
